messages:
ryan (support): heads up: multiple customers reporting embeddings failing with 400 dimension errors and some seeing 429s. Started ~2026-03-15T12:05:xxZ. Customer sample in thread.

taylor (oncall): I'm on it. Alert: embeddings-prod eu-west error-rate spike + queue depth on pool-embeddings-eu-west. https://internal.monitoring/alerts/embeddings/18676

ryan (support): customer payload (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["a","b"]}'
```
Response: 400 `{\"error\":\"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1024 but got 1536\"}`. Another customer got 429 with `{\"error\":\"queue_full\"}`.

li (eng-ml): that error text means the serving model is emitting 1536 dims but the model manifest says 1024. Did a variant with larger head get promoted? Checking model-catalog.

deploy-bot: deploy: model/embed-large v3 -> embeddings-prod-eu-west (revision 2026-03-15-11:50) by li.

sam (eng-runtime): runtime logs show many batches failing shape checks: `tensor.resize: expected (N,1024) but got (N,1536)` then the batcher emits `dropped_batch` and falls back more frequently, causing 429s. Also seeing memory pressure and OOM-kernel warnings on a subset of nodes.

taylor (oncall): impact assessment? Number of customers affected?

ryan (support): at least 8 paying customers reported failures, one reported an in-prod job retried multiple times and hit billing alarms.

billing-bot: alert: duplicate charge risk detected for customer cid_873 due to 4 retries in 2 minutes. Flagging for credit.

li (eng-ml): v3 was meant to be promoted behind `embed-large-v3` name, but catalog mapping accidentally replaced `embed-large` pointer. So name collision. We need immediate rollback of the mapping or force router to v2.

sam (eng-runtime): quick mitigation plan: 1) add a router override to pin `embed-large` -> `embed-large:v2`; 2) scale pool nodes + prewarm a couple of larger-memory instances to handle any leftover v3 traffic; 3) temporarily increase per-request batch timeout to reduce queue churn. I can flip router rule fast.

taylor (oncall): do the router canary at 20% first, watch error rate, then flip. Ryan, can you tell customers we're rolling back and issuing credits where needed?

ryan (support): yes I'll notify them. Replying to affected customers now: "we're rolling back model mapping to restore compatibility; ETA ~5-10m; we'll issue credits for failed requests."

sam (eng-runtime): applying routing override: `router.apply_override("embed-large","embed-large:v2",canary=20)`

autoscale-bot: scaling pool-embeddings-eu-west +1 high-mem instance requested by sam. ETA ~4m.

li (eng-ml): creating PR to revert catalog pointer: https://git.internal/redwood/model-catalog/pull/1250. Also adding a safety check in CI to prevent a pointer overwrite when feature gate not set.

deploy-bot: router-override event created by sam. canary=20%

taylor (oncall): monitoring: canary 20% reduced 400s in canary to 0% and overall error rate dropped from 14% -> 7%. Good sign. Proceed to full flip when autoscale live.

sam (eng-runtime): promoting override to 100% now. `router.promote_override("embed-large")`

autoscale-bot: new instance healthy and joined pool-embeddings-eu-west.

ryan (support): customers confirming success for most. One still sees cached SDK metadata mismatch. Advising them to update SDK or explicitly use `model=embed-large:v2` until SDK refreshes.

billing-bot: issued provisional credit to cid_873 for the retry charges. Will follow up with finance for final reconciliation.

li (eng-ml): merge PR to revert model-catalog pointer: merged. Also adding preflight test to verify output dim matches catalog for promoted variants.

taylor (oncall): timeline notes:
- 12:05 UTC: alert triggered; 8 customers reporting 400/429.
- 12:07: rollback routing canary 20% applied.
- 12:12: autoscale instance ready.
- 12:14: override promoted to 100%.
- 12:18: error rate back to baseline.

ryan (support): all affected customers acknowledged fix; healing complete. I'll collect list of customers + support tickets for billing reconciliation.

sam (eng-runtime): saved router diffs and logs to /artifacts/incidents/1867604321/. Will include batcher metrics and memory graphs.

li (eng-ml): follow-ups: enforce model name hygiene (no silent pointer swaps), CI preflight to assert dims, and add an explicit dimension-change gating step in model promotion playbook.

taylor (oncall): action items assigned:
- li: CI model-dim preflight + promotion gating (P0 next sprint).
- sam: improve hot-start autoscale path for large embeddings (P1).
- infra: review instance types for memory headroom (P1).
- support: compile affected customers and billing tickets (P1).

billing-bot: incident 1867604321 marked RESOLVED at +00:06:00.

taylor (oncall): closing thread; if anyone has more notes, append here. Thanks team.
